comparison.objective: Hand a garden-hose nozzle over a fence and place it in a trough while leaving the hose draped over the fence; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handoff and deformable-hose routing versus rigid precision tooling, regulated impact, and tiny-fragment search/recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Nozzle in trough, hose draped, and released versus four safe fractures with all tangs in a tray and no insert/shell damage.
comparison.reason: The record tests extended deformable-object transfer and routing, not localized impact fracture. It has no spec versions or geometric scoring tolerances.
